user_saw: Nothing visible; the process-owned camera manager kept a reference to a destroyed MainActivity until a replacement Activity attached.
summary: CameraCaptureManager now observes the attached lifecycle owner, clears its reference on ON_DESTROY, removes the old observer on replacement and ignores already-destroyed owners.
reasoning: Issue #195636 came from code review and reports only a retained destroyed Activity; the PR keeps the existing foreground admission that already stopped captures from binding to a stale owner, and the only device evidence is a trace showing the reference held until the next attach, with no reported failure. The strong `lifecycleOwner = owner` reference goes back past the January 2026 package renames to the original Android node code, so no introducing commit could be pinned. A stricter reader could call it a never-worked memory leak, but with no observed user failure and no traceable cause, I classify it as leak hardening.
